description: ASK FOR A TABLE INSTEAD OF A PAGE. Name WHICH nodes (a CSS selector, a role, a name fragment — any combination, scoped with `within`) and WHICH of their properties to take, and get back exactly that, once. «Every row in the list with its name and price», «every link in the nav and where it points», «all the inputs with what they currently hold» are one call here and a dozen with qa_snapshot plus qa_read. Take any of: text · value (what the control HOLDS, read the way the fill engine reads it) · name (accessible name) · role · tag · selector · href · state (disabled/required/invalid/expanded/checked/hidden) · geometry — plus attr:<name> for an attribute and style:<css-property> for a computed style. A property nobody can supply is named back rather than dropped, so a missing column is never mistaken for a missing feature. Read-only, and the vocabulary is closed: this is a different projection of the page, never a program the page runs.

frameId.description: Which frame to ask, from qa_frames. Omit for the page itself. A payment form, an SSO step or an embedded widget usually lives in a frame of its own, and a cross-origin one can only be read from inside it.

limit.description: Cap the rows (max 300). A capped answer says so rather than looking complete.

nodes.description: Which nodes. At least one of selector / role / nameContains; collecting the whole page is what qa_snapshot is for.

nameContains.description: Keep only nodes whose accessible name or text contains this (case-insensitive)

role.description: ARIA role (or tag name) the nodes must have, e.g. "listitem", "link"

selector.description: CSS selector the nodes must match

visibleOnly.description: Default true — hidden nodes are counted out and their number reported

within.description: Scope the search to this container

omit.description: Drop these field paths and keep the rest — the cheap way to lose one huge field (["html"], ["steps"]) without listing everything you want.

properties.description: Same as `take`, for when that is the word that came to mind.

select.description: Keep only these field paths, e.g. ["ok","fields[].name"]. Dots walk into objects, and a path through a list applies to every entry, keeping it a list. A path that matches nothing is reported back with the field names that ARE there.

tabId.description: Target tab (from qa_tabs); omit for the active tab

take.description: Which properties, e.g. ["name","value","state"] or ["text","attr:data-id","style:color"]. Default ["name","text"]. Alias: `properties`.

name: qa_collect
title: Collect named properties of named nodes
